question: A cuboid has a volume of 350 cm³ and its length is twice its height. If the breadth is 7 cm, find its dimensions.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height = 350 cm³

Given Breadth = 7 cm, so Length × Height = 350 ÷ 7 = 50

Since Length = 2 × Height (H), we have 2H × H = 50 ⇒ 2H² = 50 ⇒ H² = 25 ⇒ H = 5 cm.

Therefore, Length = 2 × 5 = 10 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 cm × 7 cm × 5 cm.**
